name: Stable Labeled Sample Compression / VC Dimension
details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $\mathrm{sLSC}(\mathcal H)\geq\lceil\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$.
proof_source: Theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star in the LaTeX survey; cor:stable-compression-vc is retained as an alias after consolidation.
